ENGAGEMENT LETTER

Dear Client,

We are pleased to confirm our engagement. The terms of our representation are set forth below.

1. SCOPE OF REPRESENTATION
Our representation is limited to the matter described above.

2. FEES AND BILLING
Our fees will be billed at our standard hourly rates.

3. TERMINATION
Either party may terminate this engagement upon thirty (30) days' written notice.

Sincerely,
[Attorney Name]

unresolvedAnchors.sourceExcerpt: The indemnification clause in Section 4 should be strengthened to explicitly cover third-party claims.
The confidentiality provisions do not address digital communications including email and cloud storage.
